title: "Hal harvester"

🧭 Back to [Harvesters Overview](overview.qmd)

## Data source

The HAL harvester fetches data from the [HAL API](https://api.archives-ouvertes.fr/docs/search).

## Supported identifiers

- idhali
- idhals
- orcid

> ℹ️ HAL identifiers take priority over orcid. When both idhali and idhals are provided, idhali is used. The
> harvester does **not** check consistency between idhali and idhals — the client system is expected to provide
> consistent data.

## Data conversion

HAL document types are mapped to RDF classes, and HAL author qualities are mapped to LoC roles, following the tables
provided in the
[CRISalid data model documentation](https://www.esup-portail.org/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=1352335371#GECMod%C3%A9lisation-MappingHAL-SoVisu+)
(document types) and the same page's "Typologie des rôles" section (author roles).
